nodes.name: proxy.go
nodes.summary: Port-forwarding proxy that exposes an in-cluster Vault pod on a local port for e2e tests.

nodes.name: proxy
nodes.summary: Local port-forward proxy state for reaching an in-cluster Vault pod.

nodes.name: newProxy
nodes.summary: Allocates a free local port and constructs a proxy for the named Vault pod.

nodes.name: freePort
nodes.summary: Finds an available TCP port by briefly listening on localhost.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Starts a SPDY port-forward with automatic reconnection until stopped.

nodes.name: stop
nodes.summary: Signals the port-forwarder to stop and waits for it to finish.

nodes.name: setup.go
nodes.summary: Vault PKI initializer that mounts root and intermediate PKI engines and configures AppRole, Kubernetes, and client-certificate auth for issuer tests.
nodes.languageNotes: Each test scenario mounts and unmounts its own PKI paths on a shared Vault server.

nodes.name: VaultInitializer
nodes.summary: Stateful Vault PKI initializer that tracks mount points, roles, and auth paths for a test PKI.

nodes.name: NewVaultInitializerClientCertificate
nodes.summary: Creates an initializer configured for client-certificate auth with randomized mount and role names.

nodes.name: NewVaultInitializerAppRole
nodes.summary: Creates an initializer configured for AppRole authentication.

nodes.name: NewVaultInitializerKubernetes
nodes.summary: Creates an initializer configured for Kubernetes service-account auth against the given API server.

nodes.name: NewVaultInitializerAllAuth
nodes.summary: Creates an initializer that configures AppRole, Kubernetes, and client-certificate auth together.

nodes.name: Init
nodes.summary: Builds a Vault client over the port-forward proxy and waits for the Vault server to become healthy.

nodes.name: Setup
nodes.summary: Mounts root and intermediate PKI engines, generates a CA chain, imports the intermediate, and configures auth backends.

nodes.name: Clean
nodes.summary: Unmounts the PKI and auth mounts created for the test.

nodes.name: CreateAppRole
nodes.summary: Creates an AppRole with a generated secret ID and returns the credential pair.

nodes.name: CleanAppRole
nodes.summary: Deletes the AppRole and its secret ID from Vault.

nodes.name: mountPKI
nodes.summary: Enables and tunes a PKI secrets engine at the given mount point.

nodes.name: generateRootCert
nodes.summary: Generates a self-signed root CA inside the root PKI mount.

nodes.name: generateIntermediateSigningReq
nodes.summary: Creates a CSR for an intermediate CA in the intermediate mount.

nodes.name: signCertificate
nodes.summary: Signs a CSR with the root CA to produce an intermediate certificate.

nodes.name: importSignIntermediate
nodes.summary: Imports the signed intermediate CA chain into the intermediate mount.

nodes.name: configureCert
nodes.summary: Writes the CA chain and CRL URLs into the PKI mount configuration.

nodes.name: configureIntermediateRoles
nodes.summary: Creates the intermediate signing role used for certificate issuance.

nodes.name: setupAppRoleAuth
nodes.summary: Enables the AppRole auth backend and wires it to the PKI mount.

nodes.name: setupKubernetesBasedAuth
nodes.summary: Enables and configures Kubernetes auth, including the token reviewer role.

nodes.name: CreateKubernetesRole
nodes.summary: Creates a service account, role binding, and Vault Kubernetes auth role for a namespace.

nodes.name: CleanKubernetesRole
nodes.summary: Removes a Vault Kubernetes auth role and its associated RBAC resources.

nodes.name: RoleAndBindingForServiceAccountRefAuth
nodes.summary: Builds the Role and RoleBinding allowing a service account to authenticate to Vault.

nodes.name: CreateKubernetesRoleForServiceAccountRefAuth
nodes.summary: Creates RBAC for service-account-ref auth and registers the Vault role.

nodes.name: CleanKubernetesRoleForServiceAccountRefAuth
nodes.summary: Deletes the Vault role and RBAC used by service-account-ref auth.

nodes.name: setupClientCertAuth
nodes.summary: Enables the cert auth backend and configures its CA certificate.

nodes.name: CreateClientCertRole
nodes.summary: Generates a client certificate and creates a cert-auth role bound to it.

nodes.name: vault.go
nodes.summary: Vault addon that deploys a Vault Helm chart, generates mTLS serving and client certificates, and exposes connection details to tests.

nodes.name: Vault
nodes.summary: Vault addon configuration embedding the chart addon plus mTLS and proxy state.

nodes.name: Details
nodes.summary: Connection details (URLs, CA, client certificate) exposed to tests that use Vault.

nodes.name: convertInterfaceToDetails
nodes.summary: Decodes transferred global addon data into concrete Vault details.

nodes.name: Setup
nodes.summary: Prepares Vault's namespace, certificates, chart values, and shared state, generating mTLS material as needed.

nodes.name: Provision
nodes.summary: Deploys Vault via the chart addon and waits for the pod and port-forward proxy to be ready.

nodes.name: Deprovision
nodes.summary: Stops the proxy and uninstalls the Vault Helm release.

nodes.name: generateVaultServingCert
nodes.summary: Issues a serving certificate for the Vault service DNS name from the test CA.

nodes.name: generateVaultClientCert
nodes.summary: Issues a client certificate for authenticating to Vault.

nodes.name: GenerateCA
nodes.summary: Generates a self-signed CA and private key used to secure the Vault deployment.

nodes.name: cloud.go
nodes.summary: Venafi Cloud addon that provisions API credentials and builds Venafi Cloud Issuer and ClusterIssuer resources for e2e tests.

nodes.name: VenafiCloud
nodes.summary: Venafi Cloud addon state including namespace, details, and the created credential secret.

nodes.name: CloudDetails
nodes.summary: Holds the issuer template used to build Venafi Cloud issuers.

nodes.name: Setup
nodes.summary: Loads suite config and prepares the namespace and issuer template for Venafi Cloud.

nodes.name: Provision
nodes.summary: Creates the Venafi Cloud API key secret and issuer template resources.

nodes.name: BuildIssuer
nodes.summary: Builds a namespaced Venafi Cloud Issuer from the stored template.

nodes.name: BuildClusterIssuer
nodes.summary: Builds a cluster-scoped Venafi Cloud ClusterIssuer from the stored template.

nodes.name: SetAPIKey
nodes.summary: Updates the stored secret with a new Venafi Cloud API key.

nodes.name: doc.go
nodes.summary: Package documentation for the Venafi addon, describing how e2e tests obtain Venafi TPP credentials.
